tech.onesa_desc1: Onesa AI muenzaniso wedu wakagadzirirwa kujekesa nzira yekugara, kudyara mari, nekubudirira muZimbabwe. Kunyangwe michina yeAI yakajairika isina ruzivo rwemuno, Onesa akavakwa kubva pasi kuti anzwisise Zimbabwe kudarika mumwe muenzaniso upi zvawo.
tech.onesa_desc2: Kubva pakuziva mitemo yemuno kusvika pakufunga mazano ebhizimusi anopedza matambudziko eZimbabwe, Onesa anopa ruzivo rwemuno rwaunoda kuti ubudirire.
tech.onesa_local_edge_desc: Michina yakajairika ndeyekuMadokero, inogona mabasa mumaindasitiri makuru asi inokundikana kuziva hupfumi hwe "kukiya-kiya" hweMbare Musika kana kudzama kweChishona chakasanganiswa nechiNdebele chekumusha.
tech.diaspora_unlocked_desc: Tinoshandisa tekinoroji yemhando yepamusoro kufambisa kushanya, kutengeserana, nekudyara mari pasina zvipingamupinyi. Chikuva chedu chinovhara gaka riri pakati pevekunze nemikana yemuno kuburikidza nekubuda pachena kwedigital neruzivo rweAI.
tech.ai_demo_question: Ndeapi mikana yekudyara mari ine mubereko mukuru muchikamu chezvekurima muZimbabwe iye zvino?
tech.ai_demo_response: Chikamu chezvekurima muZimbabwe chiri kuona kukura kukuru mukutengeswa kwezvibereko zvehorticulture kunze. Tichitarisa zviri kuitika iye zvino, kudyara mari mukutakura nekuchengetedza michero ye-blueberry kubva kuEastern Highlands kunopa mubereko mukuru nenjodzi iri pakati nepakati...
tech.features_subtitle: Zvishandiso zvakasarudzika zvakagadzirirwa kuvhara gaka riri pakati pevekunze nemikana yemuno.
tech.cta_desc: Batana nechirongwa chedu che-beta uve wekutanga kuona ruzivo rwaOnesa AI.

vicfalls.name: Victoria Falls
vicfalls.desc: Imwe yeSeven Natural Wonders of the World, mapopoma makuru pasi rose.
vicfalls.summary: Inozivikanwa nemuno seMosi-oa-Tunya (Utsi Hunotinhira). Victoria Falls kureba kwayo kupfuura Niagara Falls kaviri. Unogona kuita white-water rafting, bungee jumping, nekushanyira Devil's Pool.

greatzim.name: Great Zimbabwe
greatzim.desc: Matongo emabwe ekare anoratidza hunyanzvi hwekuvaka hweAfrica.
greatzim.summary: Yakovakwa pakati pemakore e-11 ne-15, Great Zimbabwe ndiyo yaive guta guru reHumambo hweZimbabwe. Mabwe aya akaturikidzana pasina dhaka.

kariba.name: Dhamu reKariba
kariba.desc: Rimwe remadziva makuru akagadzirwa nevanhu pasi rose, rakakodzera kuredza hove nekufamba nemabhoti.
kariba.summary: Lake Kariba rine makiromita anodarika 5,500. Rakakurumbira nekuredza tiger fish nekuzorora mumahouseboats.

rocks.name: Balancing Rocks
rocks.desc: Mabwe akaturikidzana nenzira yechisikigo anomirira nhaka yeZimbabwe.
rocks.summary: Mabwe aya anowanikwa pamari yeZimbabwe uye anowanikwa munyika yose, zvikuru kuMatobo National Park.

tourism.other_attractions_subtitle: Pamusoro penzvimbo dzinozivikanwa idzi, Zimbabwe ine dzimwe nzvimbo dzakawanda dzine mhuka dzesango.

hwange.name: Hwange National Park
hwange.desc: Paki huru muZimbabwe, inozivikanwa nemazana enzou nemhuka dzakawanda.
hwange.summary: Hwange ine makiromita anodarika 14,000. Ine mhuka dzinoyamwisa dzinodarika marudzi zana neshiri dzinodarika mazana mana.

matobo.name: Matobo National Park
matobo.desc: Nzvimbo yeUNESCO inozivikanwa nemabwe akaturikidzana nhoroondo yemweya.
matobo.summary: Matobo Hills ine nzvimbo dzekare dzine mifananidzo yakadhirowewa nevaSan.

eastern_highlands.name: Eastern Highlands
eastern_highlands.desc: Dunhu rine makomo, rine mhepo inotonhorera, masango, nemapopoma.
eastern_highlands.summary: Inosanganisira makomo eNyanga, Vumba, neChimanimani. Nzvimbo iyi yakasiyana nedzimwe muZimbabwe nekuda kwekunononhora kwayo.

mana_pools.name: Mana Pools National Park
mana_pools.desc: Nzvimbo yeUNESCO inozivikanwa nemadziva emurwizi nenzendo dzekutsoka.
mana_pools.summary: Inowanikwa muZambezi Valley, Mana Pools inozivikanwa nerunako rwayo nemadziva mana makuru akagadzirwa nerwizi.

nyanga.name: Nyanga National Park
nyanga.desc: Inonzi 'Little Scotland' yeAfrica, kumba kwegomo rakanyanya kureba nemapopoma akadzika.
nyanga.summary: Nyanga iparadhiso ine Gomo reNyangani neMutarazi Falls (mapopoma echipiri kureba muAfrica).

gonarezhou.name: Gonarezhou National Park
gonarezhou.desc: Inonzi 'Nzvimbo dzeNzou,' inozivikanwa nemawere matsvuku eChilojo.
gonarezhou.summary: Gonarezhou ipaki yechipiri pakukura muZimbabwe, ine runako rwemawere e-sandstone.
